messages:
Jules (CS): Quick heads-up 48: we're planning a 75-minute Enablement Lab aimed at customers currently in onboarding + a 15m renewal-risk triage segment. Need to pick a time next week and confirm owners. Proposed slots: Thu 08:30-09:45 PT, Thu 17:00-18:15 CET, Fri 11:00-12:15 ET. Reply with emoji for preferred slot or add to the poll: https://polly.example/s/lab2026 :spiral_calendar:
Rina CSM: Thu PT is ideal for my accounts. I'll mark 3 customers as "must invite" (they're low activation). Will add their PMs to the invite.
Omar (Enablement): I'm happy to facilitate. Draft agenda below — open to tweaks:
```
- 0-10m: Welcome + expected outcomes
- 10-40m: Guided migration clinic (hands-on, bring your repo/config)
- 40-55m: Observability & cost control quick wins
- 55-70m: Renewal-risk triage: signals & playbook (15m)
- 70-75m: Next steps + resources
```
Ben (Ops): Can we ask customers to do two prechecks 48h before? 1) Confirm CLI installed, 2) Upload a short prompt sample. Keeps the migration clinic practical. I can publish a prework checklist in the shared folder.
Sofia (Analytics): For the renewal triage segment, I'll bring a short dashboard showing usage & anomaly signals (5 slides). Also propose a 1-question pre-survey: "How confident are you that your integration will be production-ready in 2 weeks? (1-5)" and the same question post-session.
Maya: Recording? Please set to auto-record and add captions. Also can someone take quick timestamps for the demo sections so we can link highlights for customers who skip parts.
Jules (CS): Good call. Action owners: Rina invite accounts; Omar run the lab; Ben prepare prework doc; Sofia prepare dashboard + survey; Maya handle captions & notes. CalendarBot: Poll created: https://polly.example/s/lab2026  Current votes: Thu PT (4), Thu CET (2), Fri ET (3)  Poll closes in 36h.
Rina CSM: FYI a couple of invites will include procurement contacts  can we add a 2m note about billing/committed capacity during intros? Might surface renewal blockers.
Omar (Enablement): Yep — add a 2-slide "commercial signals to watch" appendix. I'll coordinate with product to make sure messaging matches offer T&Cs.
Ben (Ops): Prework checklist (draft) I'll post in the shared drive: https://drive.example/r/enablement-lab/prework.txt. Quick snippet: ```1) Install CLI v0.9.2; 2) Share 1-2 prompt examples; 3) Grant read access to logs for the session```
Sofia (Analytics): I'll wire the pre/post survey via Typeform and include a hidden field for account id so we can measure changes by customer. Will share results in cohort folder.
Maya: I'll create the meeting and enable recording + auto-upload to the customer folder. Will also drop a short summary note with timestamps within 24h.
Jules (CS): Nice. One more ask: after the session let's queue a 20m CS follow-up for any accounts flagged as "still low confidence". That'll be on CSMs to schedule.
Omar (Enablement): Agreed. I'll add a post-session playbook doc with suggested next steps and a sample outreach template for CSMs.
Jules (CS): Perfect. Final checklist before poll closes: confirm slot (react), owners (ack), prework doc live, survey link ready. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
